subject: general
question: Seven people, A, B, C, D, E, F and G, are sitting in a row, facing north. Only three people sit between D and E. B sits to the immediate left of E. No one sits to the right of G. Only two people sit between G and B. A sits to the immediate right of F. How many people sit to the right of C?
solution:
**Given:**

Seven people A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting in a row facing north.

• Only three people sit between D and E.

• B sits to the immediate left of E.

• No one sits to the right of G.

• Only two people sit between G and B.

• A sits to the immediate right of F.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0b490566716a7a35f8edc3302cb218e8a84d57fb91a1512a3fc903314877a88c.png] 

Only G sits to the right of C.

Therefore, **1 person** sits to the right of C.

**Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".**
